question: At fixed volume fraction (phi_eff 10%), does the SiC scattering contrast keep falling between R = 3 and 5 nm with the measured 2-to-3 nm slope, or does it stop falling?

method.engine: identical to r30_design.json (ledger 103) and md_design.json (ledger 58): LAMMPS, Tersoff 1989 + inert Ge-C triplets, Muller-Plathe rNEMD, NPT 50 ps, warm 100 ps, production 500 ps, swap every 50 steps, 20 z-bins, x = 0.2, T = 300 K; in.sic_particle, SiCGe_GeC.tersoff and analyze_mp.py are byte-identical copies of ../r30/
method.only_change: box size via -var ncxy/ncz by the same geometric scaling as ledger 103: R = 5.0 nm in 30 x 30 x 100 cells (5/3 x the R = 3.0 nm box; phi_eff 10.1%, as R = 3.0 nm in ledger 104 and R = 2.0 nm in ledger 59), 720000 lattice sites. The Si-rich pocket stays R + 7 A (not scaled)
method.runs: points.txt: pocket-only control and particle, seeds 20261007 and 20261008; 4 runs
method.reference: R = 3.0 nm, phi 10% runs of ledger 104 (../r30/results) and the measured curve of ../r30/r30_results.json
method.placement: execution detail: grn061 (granite sparks-gpu-grn, 64 cores) when no sparks-partition job runs there, otherwise notchpeak-guest / owner-guest, 64 ranks, requeue; restarts from scratch on preemption (each start logged in results/*.attempts); the DGX is not used; moving between the two needs only a placement note
method.cost_estimate: ledger-104 R = 3 nm runs (155520 sites): 49-86 min on 64 ranks. 720000 sites scale to about 4-7 h per run on 64 ranks; 4 runs, 16-28 node-hours

model_predictions_at_registration.note: computed before any run with ../radius_contrast/fit_radius_contrast.py (registered frame, x = 0.2, 300 K, phi 0.101, R = 50 A), lam2(3 nm) = geometric mean of ledger-104 seeds = 1.0525e-3
model_predictions_at_registration.seed_scatter_reference: ledger-104 particle reductions at R = 3 nm: 0.247 and 0.254

gates.G1: as ledger 58 and 103: Ge-to-centre minus C-to-centre gap >= 5.7 A at start and end of every particle run
gates.G2: every run gives a finite positive kappa
gates.G3: mean C coordination at the end >= 3.3
gates.G4: the two pocket-only seeds agree within 10%

analysis.inversion: analyze_r50.py: each seed-paired reduction r = 1 - kappa(particle)/kappa(pocket-only) is inverted to lam2 exactly as analyze_r30.py does (same model side, boundary length matched to the pocket-only control of the same box, phi_eff by the analyze_md.py convention)
analysis.ratio: ratio_R5 = lam2(5.0 nm, phi 10%) / lam2(3.0 nm, phi 10%, ledger 104) over the 4 pairings of 2 new and 2 earlier seeds
analysis.threshold: t = sqrt((5/3)^-3.9) = 0.369, the log-midpoint between a constant lam2 (ratio 1) and the measured 2-to-3 nm slope (ratio 0.136)
analysis.measured_curve: lam2(R): geometric seed means at R = 1.0, 1.5, 2.0 (ledger 59), 3.0 (ledger 104) and 5.0 nm (new), log-log interpolation; beyond 5 nm the 3.0-to-5.0 nm slope (never rising). Ge saving and screening pick recomputed through fit_radius_contrast.claims and .pick

predictions.PrF2: mean r(R = 5 nm) >= 0.05 (the particle still measurably lowers kappa)
predictions.PrF3: the measured-curve 5 nm Ge saving at 300 K lies within 3 percentage points of the extrapolated 8.7% (ledger 105)

decision_rule.keeps_falling: every ratio_R5 < 0.369: strengthen the ledger-105 measured-curve claims; the 5 nm Ge saving and the preferred radius are recomputed with the measured 5 nm point and P1's label 'extrapolated beyond 3 nm' is replaced by 'measured to 5 nm'
decision_rule.stops_falling: every ratio_R5 >= 0.369: correct the 5 nm Ge saving and the screening pick to the measured-curve values with the 5 nm point; the extrapolated 7-9% at 5 nm is withdrawn
decision_rule.undecided: the ratios straddle 0.369 or a value is missing: retain the ledger-105 values with the 'extrapolated beyond 3 nm' label and record the ratios
decision_rule.gates_fail: if a gate fails, the failing runs are reported and the decision is taken only if the branch is the same without them; otherwise undecided
decision_rule.not_affected: the R <= 3 nm measured curve, the recipe composition (x = 0.3) and carbon content (3 at%), every coarse-SiC claim (bracketed at both limits in session 73), and all non-SiC claims
